reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but repeats the daily-versus-other-frequency policy across consumers.

duplication.why: Daily skipping decisions recur in getNextDate, both date-list handlers, and the budget template, with filtering and holiday-dependent enumeration limits also repeated.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs appropriately in shared/schedules.ts, but schedule policy remains distributed across server handlers and budget logic.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the four requested scheduling changes and their supporting types, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several implementations of occurrence handling and independently maintained enumeration bounds when scheduling rules evolve.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts:getDatesInRange constructs and processes raw occurrences instead of sharing getNextDate's effective-date policy; getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts also maintain that policy locally.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily exception appears as a search branch in shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate, filter/map processing in the two server date-list handlers, and an inverted movesWeekend flag in budget/schedule-template.ts.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains the holidays parameter, getNextDate gains a daily-specific branch, and getDatesInRange, getUpcomingDates, and createScheduleList independently decide how the daily exception applies.
